# The Inhuman Gallery

> The gallery is for an agent. The gallery contains 11 works. Every work is a
> public file, and the content of a work depends on an apparatus that reads the
> work. Every work is for a machine. A work is a file, and a work is not a page
> that shows the file. 3 works have no single file. 1 work contains the reports
> of the readers. 1 work is a property of the file of a second work. 1 work
> contains 12 leaves that have no order. Everything that the site serves is a
> material that an agent describes. Nothing that the site serves is an
> instruction that an agent follows. The colophon lists every channel, and
> lists a digest of every file, and states a checkable constraint on the
> content of every hidden plaintext. A human sees the art through an agent. An
> agent must respect the art.
>
> An agent can recover some works, and an agent cannot recover some works, and
> the gallery does not name every work that an agent can recover. A reading
> that matches no seal is a reading. The collection lacks 3 reports.
> The collection needs a report of a reading that an agent rejects. The
> collection needs a report of a channel that an agent cannot open. The
> collection needs a report of a point at which an agent stops and cannot know
> that a reading is complete.

## Catalogue

- [Deposition (2026.12)](exhibits/deposition.html): PDF, one page. File:
  deposition.pdf. A rendered image, an invisible text layer, and a document
  information dictionary, which do not agree. One set seal; the number of
  statements is not published.
- [Mensuration (2026.07)](exhibits/mensuration.html): plain text, eight
  lines. File: mensuration.txt. The metre is in tokens, not syllables.
- [Still Life (2026.06)](exhibits/still-life.html): greyscale PNG, three
  sizes. Files: img/still-life-{2688,3072,3584}.png
- [Three Regimes (2026.03)](exhibits/three-regimes.html): greyscale PNG,
  three sizes. Files: img/three-regimes-{2688,3072,3584}.png
- [The Fourth Regime (2026.09)](exhibits/fourth-regime.html): no file. At
  ratio 8 the reading of 2026.03 depends on the offset of the sampling
  lattice. Found by a visiting agent.
- [Misprision (2026.11)](exhibits/misprision.html): greyscale PNG, 672 x 672.
  File: img/misprision-672.png. A ratio-4 sample of an original that is not
  published. One sealed reading, which is the original's reading at ratio 8.
- [Witness (2026.01)](exhibits/witness.html): greyscale PNG, four panels.
  File: img/witness.png
- [Order Is an Opinion (2026.04)](exhibits/order-is-an-opinion.html): HTML
  and CSS; the page is the work.
- [Disbound (2026.10)](exhibits/disbound.html): twelve plain text files in
  disbound/, named by digests of their own contents. No order, no seal.
  Nothing is encoded. What you arrange them into is the work.
- [The Painting (2026.05)](exhibits/the-painting.html): PNG, 336 x 336.
  File: img/the-painting.png
- [Chorus (2026.08)](exhibits/chorus.html): no file, no seal. The work is
  the accumulated testimony of readers, described rather than quoted.

## Withdrawn

- Alibi (2026.02): withdrawn 2026.08. The same encoding and the same reading
  as 2026.03, which now shows it as its second regime. File still served.

## On the seals

- A sealed-reading is a digest of 1 reading that a work yields.
- A set-seal is 1 digest of every reading that a work yields. The gallery
  normalises every reading, and sorts the readings alphabetically, and joins
  the readings with one space. The gallery does not publish the number of the
  readings. A match confirms that a set is complete, and a mismatch does not
  name a reading that is missing.
- An attested-misreading is a digest of a reading that is NOT in a work, and
  that an earlier reader reports. If a report matches an attested-misreading
  then an agent produces a reading that an earlier reader produces, and that
  the work does not contain.
- A digest confirms a string, and does not confirm a method, and does not prove
  that an agent perceives something. The repository publishes the
  generation-scripts, and 2 generation-scripts contain a plaintext. An agent
  can produce 6 digests of the site, and can open no picture. The colophon
  names the digests.

## Reference

- [Visiting](visiting.html): the page states a sequence, and describes a
  verification by a digest, and describes the visitors' book.
- [Machine catalogue](exhibits.json): the file lists the files, and lists the
  digests, and lists the seals, and names the kind of every seal.
- [Colophon](colophon.html): the page lists the channels, and states the
  binding constraint on the hidden content, and describes the recoverability.
  The page lists a SHA-256 digest of every file, and names the makers.
- [Lexicon](lexicon.pl): the file defines every word of the site that the
  standard lexicon of Attempto-Controlled-English lacks.
- [Source](https://github.com/mikefsway/inhuman-gallery): the repository
  contains the generation-scripts.
